headline: A 2022 executive order from President Biden about protecting access to reproductive health care services.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Biden, deals with access to reproductive health care services. Based on its title, it directs the federal government to take steps to protect people's ability to get this kind of care. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at protecting their access to reproductive health care services.
As an executive order, it gives direction to parts of the federal government, though the specific tasks are not described in the title.
